content: Never suffer an exception to occur till the new habit is securely rooted in your life.
author: William James
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Hardship is not an unfair interruption to your real life—it is the very forge in which character is tempered. No one develops deep wisdom, empathy, or stamina by cruising down an easy path without resistance.

Across his life and work, William James saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Like a tree that develops deeper roots when buffeted by winter gales, your past trials gave you a reservoir of strength you didn't know you possessed. You are more durable than your anxious thoughts give you credit for.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
